AdminClubEditable.description: Complete safe public club fields only. Null clears optional fields. Unknown keys and duplicate JSON keys are rejected.

social_links.description: Only facebook, instagram, twitter, youtube and tiktok; values are nonempty safe HTTPS URLs.

MobileProfileUpdateBody.description: Updates accepted non-null own-profile fields. Null fields are ignored; at least one accepted field is required. Unknown fields are ignored.

email.description: A plain email address without a display name; empty string clears it.

favourite_player_id.description: Opaque legacy player preference; empty string clears it. This value grants no roster access.

notification_prefs.description: Replaces the whole preference object; up to 64 keys, each 1..64 characters without controls, with boolean values. Null is ignored; an empty object clears preferences.

LegacyMobile.description: Original signed mobile token, accepted only by the explicitly enabled, time-bounded exchange endpoint. CMS/customer and rewrite tokens are excluded.

post.description: Submits the current parent/player's RSVP. Status is going, not_going or maybe and defaults to going only when omitted. event_type is match, fixture (match alias), event or training; omission requires a unique event ID. Cancelled and archived events reject new RSVPs; past events otherwise remain eligible. Unknown properties are ignored; duplicate JSON keys and bodies over 16 KiB are rejected.

get.description: Returns a scoped calendar month. month is required in YYYY-MM form; offset is an integer from 0 to 100000. Each page contains at most 200 items. player_id selects an already authorized player and grants no access.

Returns scoped player RSVPs for a currently authorized coach/management identity. These are availability responses, not physical attendance or read receipts. The required event_type is match, fixture, event or training. offset is an integer from 0 to 100000; each page contains at most 200 players.
Scoped group directory only. Returns current canonical FC/Academy group IDs and names, never private participants or messages. Fan role denied; no chat send/delete endpoints are enabled by this read.

post.description: Submits an RSVP for the sole active, phone-verified, accepted family delegation. No player_id selector, player-role elevation or staff access. Each mutation revalidates the current guardian, child and revocation inside the final SQL statement.

get.description: Read-only member calendar for the exact player whose accepted family delegation is live at the same SQL statement as event visibility. Requires OTP fan role. No player selector, staff projection, RSVP write, or player-role elevation.
Returns RSVP rows only for players currently linked to the authenticated parent/player identity.
